propositions: warn_if_cache_ineffective fires on every small call below 4096-token floor despite zero cache counters being the correct expected result for sub-floor prompts
the warning's predicate checks only input_tokens > 0 and lacks a lower bound, causing it to conflate 'prompt below cacheable floor' with 'model does not cache'
repeated false warnings during each review-plan run create alarm fatigue that trains operators to filter out the signal, making it ineffective when a model genuinely stops caching
aggregate run telemetry shows caching is working (cache_write_tokens > 0) while per-call warnings simultaneously claim caching had no effect, contradicting the run's own usage numbers
CACHE_MIN_PREFIX_TOKENS constant is defined in pass1.py but warn_if_cache_ineffective in structured_run.py has no access to it, requiring either duplication or a shared definition location
